comment: Dr. Husain is the best! She's dedicated to helping students understand the material and its broader implications, so class discussions are always interesting and she has a great sarcastic sense of humor too. She keeps the class very straightforward and is amazing to talk to outside of class as well.

Very good professor. I took sociology 101 thinking that it would just fulfill my gen ed, but I found the material, the lectures, and the debates very interesting. I am going to take another class by her next year. She does a really good job at getting students to comprehend certain concepts and ideas. Highly recommend this teacher to everyone.

One of the best professors I've had in school so far and has overall inspired me to keep studying sociology. She makes discussions around sociology topics interesting and easy to understand and she's very accessible outside of class. The workload for her classes are generally very manageable and assignments aren't stressful usually.

Dr. Husain is a fun professor to have and she focuses on making sure the class understands what they have read. The syllabus says that participation matters but it's not as critical to a good grade as other classes. The papers assigned are very short and manageable, but she is more interested in comprehension than writing ability.

She is super smart and knows what shes talking about. She always made class interesting and engaging. Pretty easy grader, very straightforward with what she wants and super willing to help when needed.
Awesome teacher, assigns lots of readings, but the course load is manageable. Made a class that could have been boring very interesting
Great professor, made a boring topic much more interesting. Not too difficult. Can get an A with minimal effort
